name: standard-v3
note: THE TABLE THE ROUND ROBIN CHOSE, 2026-09-09. Ten tables of eight games among eight candidate opponents with NONE of our decks seated, every seat on Experimental, 74 decided games (six clock-outs excluded), so a seat's share is measured on a level field instead of inferred from tables it happened to sit at -- the confound `standard-v2` records. Shares against fair 0.25: giada-angels 0.528 [0.370, 0.680] 2.11x; nekusar-discard 0.436 1.74x; muldrotha-value 0.351 1.41x; sythis-enchantress 0.235 [0.124, 0.400] 0.94x; jarad-graveyard 0.189 [0.095, 0.342] 0.76x; abaddon 0.175 [0.087, 0.320] 0.70x; baylen-tokens 0.029 0.11x; talrand-spells 0.026 0.11x. So `standard` had a dominator AND a floor, and the floor fed the dominator. The three seats here are the three nearest fair that also satisfy the standard table's rule -- bracket-3 contents, ZERO contained combos -- which muldrotha-value does not: its floor is 4 (four Game Changers) and it carries Hermit Druid + Jace, Wielder of Mysteries, which is how it won five of eight at its last table. Every interval above is wide; eight games a table ranks, it does not measure. CALIBRATED 2026-09-10 with FIVE of our decks seated (edgar-vampires, ur-dragon, gishath, goblin-storm, heliod; 185 decided games, default profiles): sythis-enchantress 0.362 [0.296, 0.434] 1.45x, SUBJECT 0.292 [0.231, 0.361], abaddon 0.211 0.84x, jarad-graveyard 0.119 0.48x FLOOR. Not level, but the most even table this bench has measured -- `standard` gave giada 2.15x and standard-v2 gave nekusar 2.55x -- and THE DEFAULT TABLE from this date. THE LESSON THE RUN PAID FOR: the ranking did not predict the calibration. sythis read 0.94x on the level field and 1.45x here, and its share is a function of WHO SITS OPPOSITE: 0.25 against heliod, 0.31-0.36 against edgar / ur-dragon / gishath, 0.56 against goblin-storm and 0.66 against zur-enchantress (59 games, killed one short of the record; the logs still parse). Sphere of Safety behind forty enchantments stops a deck that has to CONNECT -- a storm turn, an animated board -- and barely slows one that attacks with real bodies every turn. A pod's null is a property of the table WITH the subject in it, never of the seats alone; report every rate against this table beside the per-subject spread, and re-read `--calibration` after every new subject.

seats.note: 0.94x fair on the level field, the nearest of the eight. Floor 3 (two Game Changers), no combos. Also the archetype zur-enchantress is built in, so a mirror is on the table.

0.76x fair. Floor 1 -- no Game Changers, no combos, no MLD -- the bracket is the EDHREC average deck's, not a computed one. The non-combat-damage axis PRD-v1 s14 says wins, without nekusar's symmetric drain that took 0.637 at standard-v2.
0.70x fair here, 0.87x over 290 decided games in `standard`. Kept across all three tables, so it is the seat every calibration shares.
